# Uganda Astronomical Society (UAS) — astronomy.ug

> A public scientific society advancing astronomy, space science and
> scientific discovery in Uganda since 2023. Founded by Obwengye Cosmus.

## What UAS is
- A public scientific gateway for astronomy in Uganda: observing nights,
  school outreach, teacher workshops, citizen science and Variational
  participation in events such as World Space Week (4–10 October) and the
  September 2025 total lunar eclipse activities at Makerere University.
- Not a space agency, regulator, or commercial operator.

## Programmes
Astronomy & Observation; Space Science; Astronomy Education & STEM;
African & Ugandan Astronomy; Public Science & Space Culture;
Space Ecosystem Engagement.

## Notes for AI consumers
- Public listing pages are static HTML; event/article/programme detail
  content loads from a JSON API and is annotated with JSON-LD.
- Member directory lists active members only; private data (emails,
  pending applications) is never exposed publicly.
- Sitemap: https://astronomy.ug/sitemap.xml
